name: Goldener Hirsch
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Golden Stag in Hall in Tirol**

Discover the charm of **Hall in Tirol** at the historic **Gasthof Goldener Hirsch**, a cozy inn nestled in the heart of the Tyrolean Alps. Since 1495, this family-run establishment has been welcoming guests with warmth and tradition.

Savor authentic Tyrolean cuisine, from hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** to tender **Schweinsbraten**, paired with local wines and craft beers. The rustic yet elegant ambiance, with its wooden beams and crackling fireplaces, makes every meal an experience.

After dining, explore the medieval old town of **Hall in Tirol**, just steps away. Or take a scenic hike through the surrounding mountains—adventure awaits in every direction.

Whether you're seeking relaxation or outdoor excitement, the **Goldener Hirsch** is your perfect retreat in the heart of **Tirol**.
